text: Ɓe yeddi ɗee Aayeeje ɓannguɗe ɓe qirritaaki ɗe, wonkiiji maɓɓe ɗin yananaa wonndema ko ɗe immorde ka Alla; sabu tooñe maɓɓe ɗen e mawnitinaare maɓɓe nden gaayi Goonga kan, tasko -an Nulaaɗo- ko honno wonirnoo battane bonnirooɓe ɓen ka leydi keeferaaku maɓɓe ngun e geddi maɓɓe ɗin, gomɗii Men halkii ɓe, Men yirbiniiɓe ɓe fow maɓɓe.
